title: Sustainable Faith … in Florida, coming soon!

body: The Sustainable Faith Conference will explore the vital connections between ecology, incarnation, and interconnectivity. It’s April 20-21st, in sunny St. Petersburg Florida. Join me (Brian McLaren), Bernice Powell Jackson, Doug Pagitt, Trip Fuller, and many more voices as we discover together how faith and creation care are deeply connected. Check out asustainablefaith.com for a list of speakers, breakout sessions, and more. (I’m really looking forward to being part of this event. Maybe you should come?)
